I have the list of orders and refunds. Now I need to compute the net balance for each customer (order amount minus refunds). I'll calculate per customer: acme has orders 210 and 213, birch has 211 and 214, cobalt has 212 and 215. Then I'll record payouts using net_balance for each customer.
I have the net balance for customer 'acme'. Next I'll get net balance for 'birch'.
